content.value_statement: Teams need structured security governance for ISO 27001 and healthcare audits. This skill guides ISMS planning, risk assessment, controls, and certification preparation.
actual_capabilities: Maps ISMS work to ISO 27001 planning, operation, monitoring, and improvement activities.
Guides asset classification, threat analysis, risk evaluation, and risk treatment planning.
Explains ISO 27002 organizational, people, physical, and technological control areas.
Supports healthcare and medical device security planning with HIPAA, FDA, and IEC 62304 context.
Helps draft policy frameworks, audit programs, management reviews, and security metrics.
limitations: It does not include complete referenced scripts or templates; bundled files are placeholders.
It cannot certify an organization or replace an accredited ISO 27001 auditor.
It does not run live vulnerability scans, SIEM integrations, or cloud account checks.
Legal, regulatory, and patient safety decisions still require qualified review.

use_cases.title: Plan a New ISMS
use_cases.description: Create an ISO 27001 roadmap with scope, policies, risk methods, control work, metrics, and review cadence.

use_cases.title: Assess Security Risk
use_cases.description: Structure asset inventories, threat analysis, risk ratings, treatment plans, and evidence needed for management review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Audit Evidence
use_cases.description: Organize control evidence, internal audit scope, certification readiness work, and healthcare security compliance notes.

prompt_templates.title: Create an ISMS Starter Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a small regulated team.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ISO 27001 ISMS starter plan for a HealthTech company with 40 employees. Include scope, owners, policies, and first milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Risk Assessment
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate risk work for a defined service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide a security risk assessment for our patient data platform. Cover assets, threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood, impact, and treatment choices.

prompt_templates.title: Map ISO 27002 Controls
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced control selection and evidence planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map ISO 27002 controls for a cloud-hosted medical device portal. Include control intent, evidence, owners, and implementation priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Certification Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert preparation before an external audit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a certification readiness plan for ISO 27001 Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits. Include gaps, evidence, interviews, and management review topics.

output_examples.input: A HealthTech startup asks for a first ISO 27001 plan.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a scoped ISMS roadmap, required policies, risk assessment steps, owners, and certification preparation milestones.

output_examples.input: A MedTech team needs device security controls.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines device threat modeling, authentication, encryption, update management, monitoring, incident response, and supporting evidence.

output_examples.input: A compliance manager needs audit preparation help.
output_examples.output: The skill provides an audit readiness checklist, management review topics, control evidence needs, and remediation planning guidance.

best_practices: Provide the organization scope, assets, data types, and regulatory obligations before asking for guidance.
Ask for evidence expectations and owners when planning controls or audit readiness work.
Review outputs with qualified security, privacy, and quality stakeholders before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated guidance as certification approval or legal advice.
Do not ask for generic controls without describing assets, threats, and business context.
Do not use the placeholder files as complete implementation scripts or policy templates.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Security, risk, compliance, and quality teams working on ISO 27001 or healthcare security governance can use it.

faq.question: Does it support ISO 27001:2022?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance references ISO 27001:2022 ISMS activities and ISO 27002 control areas.

faq.question: Can it replace an auditor?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare evidence and plans, but certification decisions require an accredited audit body.

faq.question: Does it include working automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The bundled script and reference files are placeholders, so automation must be built separately.

faq.question: Can it help with medical device security?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes planning guidance for device cybersecurity, FDA context, IEC 62304 alignment, and healthcare data protection.

faq.question: Does it perform live security testing?
faq.answer: No. It can structure testing plans and evidence, but it does not scan systems or connect to cloud services.
